name: Lucie Zhang
bio: Lucie Zhang is a French actress. She received critical acclaim for her feature film debut Paris, 13th District (2021),which earned her César and Lumières Award nominations. She appeared on the UniFrance and Screen International list of rising French talents to watch.

credits.overview: A nearsighted neighbor, silent police officers, a suspicious Chinese family... A drama inspired by real events, where a series of events leads to the death of a man and breaks the silence of a community.

credits.overview: On the cusp of success/failure, two unhinged female filmmakers decide to break up with their boyfriends, and for once, make a bold decision with their lives.

credits.title: La sélection
credits.overview: Raphaël, a photographer in search of recognition, has to take the portrait of a Korean singer visiting Paris. After a laborious photo shoot, he is forced to select the images with Lucie, a member of the celebrity's team. With their different points of view, they gradually learn to get to know each other.

credits.title: 43° à l’ombre
credits.overview: In a house dripping with sunlight, five friends live on lollipops and hot coffee. Between two swims, they challenge each other to a game of bilboquet or share a feast cooked by Pauline. Meanwhile, Ferdinand is desperately searching for a lost object. Sounds like a serious story.
